_comment: The neighborhoods, map points and table cells on /buyers/best-neighborhoods/ (batch 2026-10-b, page 1). Every cell comes from a verified row in batches/2026-10-b/facts/neighborhoods-facts.md (the verifier's 'OK to use on the page as' wording and the corrected beach rows), except The Farm (batches/2026-10-b/facts/the-farm-facts.md, rows 5, 28, 47, 48, 71), Tidewater's price and fee (batches/2026-10-b/facts/gated-communities-facts.md rows 20 and 43, so the gated page and this page show one value) and the four 55+ communities (batches/2026-10-a/data/55-plus-communities.json, by reference). Prices: the middle recorded resale, October 2025 to September 2026, rounded; a range (the verifier's middle half or full range) where fewer than 20 sold; houses and other types apart where one figure blends them. Fees: the fee sellers entered on listings in October 2026 (The Farm: the HOA's 2026 budget). Beach: minutes by car with no traffic from the neighborhood's middle to the nearest public beach access (The Farm: from the Farmers Rest Drive entrance). Map points: the reference point of each neighborhood (a county address point near the middle of its homes; the address is never shown), The Farm at the middle of its 1,634 parcels. Round 2 (2026-10-13): fees rounded to one figure where the verifier's 'most often' value exists (ROUND-2 item 5); 'Ask us' replaced by rows 177 and 178; the beach column says 'by car, no traffic' in its heading. Round 3 (2026-10-13): Grande Dunes uses the gated page's group and values (one fact, one value); the Cherry Grove HOA cell in the yearly cost table reads 'None on most homes' (row 177: 52 of 89 listed with no fee). Round 14 (2026-10-15): the neighborhoods are in the order of the selection guide (walk to the beach, golf, the water, a town center, new homes and big pools, room and value), which is the order of the entries and the map numbers. Round 14d (2026-10-15): Berkshire Forest replaced by Avalon (rows 270 to 274, pending verification); Grande Dunes is the whole community in this page's own shape; Prince Creek without Bellwood Landing; order: walk to the beach, golf, a boat, a town center, lower prices. The yearly cost table is replaced by the yearly HOA fee by guide group (fee_by_group, row 275). Round 14l (2026-10-21): order follows the new guide groups (golf close by, new houses, more house for the money); Grande Dunes moved to new houses, Deerfield before Avalon; fee cells say 'for sale' (v10 N23). Round 14n (2026-10-21): Forestbrook Estates cut (OWNER-EYE-14m H1: nothing a buyer could not guess). Grande Dunes cut too (OWNER-EYE-14m re-check: no day there that the gated page does not own).
